comment: Professor/Dean Thompson is a very good option for BComm. She has a very clear grading criteria and makes the class interesting. She is very nice, personable, and charismatic. The final is a product or business pitch which is fun and you can do this individually or with a partner.

She is such an amazing professor. The class is very easy if you pay attention and have attention to detail on homework. Most grades are full credit, and rubrics are really easy to follow and get 100%. Class is mandatory every week, but it is enjoyable. Also, it's a lot easier from other BComm classes from what I've heard.

Dean Thompson is a wonderful professor and this is a very useful class to take. My only criticism is that you don't  really have a great idea of your grade until the end (she rarely hands back assignments), but I think that she would let you know if you aren't doing as well as expected. Overall, BUAD 205 with Dean Thompson was a great experience.

Good useful class. You will draft/finalize a cover letter, resume, LinkedIn profile etc while working on interviewing, presenting, and developing a "personal brand". Dean Thompson is a fun professor, but assignments are due every week, so definitely more work than a 0.5 unit course.
